game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents, a tented desert bazaar: the oasis keeper must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents: a tented desert bazaar
core_gameplay_loop: In Bazaar Tents, repeat each round: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order. Each round, giant scorpions strike the sandstone arch, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the program_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sandstone arch from giant scorpions in Bazaar Tents: keep the program_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: program_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Program Assembler
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Program Assembler' (Week 9 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Bazaar Tents'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how program_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Bazaar Tents.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while program_ok > 0.
